name: contrast-checker
description: WCAG对比度检查器，输入前景背景色即显示合规等级，带色盲模拟预览
interaction: Input foreground and background colors to instantly see WCAG compliance levels (AA/AAA) with real-time contrast ratio feedback. Toggle color blindness simulation modes to preview how your palette appears to users with different visual conditions. Export accessible color combinations ready for production use.
